mandatoryCriteria: Row-level locking protocol: Write transactions acquire FOR SHARE lock on actor's project_memberships row (or verify workspace ownership) before mutating project resources
Revocation serialization: Role revocation or removal acquires an exclusive lock; concurrent writes wait and re-read committed membership state
Immediate abortion on removed status: If actor's status is 'removed', write mutation transaction immediately aborts with 404 NOT_FOUND
No write commit after revocation: A write cannot commit after a preceding revocation transaction commits; strict serialization
R3 Audit compliance: Tested with concurrent requests through real PostgreSQL connection pool exercising row-level locks
scopeAndExclusions: In-scope: acquireWriteGrantLock adapter, row-level locking protocol on project_memberships, transaction boundaries, and concurrent revocation tests on PostgreSQL. Out-of-scope: Individual card mutation business logic is handled under CRD-01.
